verdict.rationale: Cline's overview documents a first-party offering to build agents and integrations on the same core engine that powers its CLI, Kanban, VS Code and JetBrains clients. That points to an official SDK-style building surface, but it rests on a single thin mention and the evidence never names the SDK, its packages, its languages, or its API reference. The probes show no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: named official SDK packages and supported languages, SDK reference documentation, install and usage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
